assertions.description: The `import defer * as ns from "..."` grammar parses and evaluates: dynamically importing a module that uses it resolves instead of throwing a SyntaxError.
assertions.test: (async()=>{try{const inner='data:text/javascript,'+encodeURIComponent('export const x=1;');const outer='data:text/javascript,'+encodeURIComponent('import defer * as n from '+JSON.stringify(inner)+';export const ok=true;');const m=await import(outer);return m.ok===true;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: A deferred module namespace object reports Symbol.toStringTag === "Deferred Module" (distinct from a normal namespace's "Module").
assertions.test: (async()=>{try{const inner='data:text/javascript,'+encodeURIComponent('export const v=1;');const outer='data:text/javascript,'+encodeURIComponent('import defer * as n from '+JSON.stringify(inner)+';export const tag=n[Symbol.toStringTag];');const m=await import(outer);return m.tag==='Deferred Module';}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: A deferred module's top-level code does not run on import, is not triggered by a Symbol key read, and runs exactly once on the first string-property access on the namespace.
assertions.test: (async()=>{try{const key='__conf_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);const inner='data:text/javascript,'+encodeURIComponent('globalThis['+JSON.stringify(key)+']=(globalThis['+JSON.stringify(key)+']||0)+1;export const v=42;');const outer='data:text/javascript,'+encodeURIComponent('import defer * as n from '+JSON.stringify(inner)+';export const tag=n[Symbol.toStringTag];export function read(){return n.v;}');const before=globalThis[key]||0;const m=await import(outer);const afterImport=globalThis[key]||0;const tagOk=m.tag==='Deferred Module';const v=m.read();const afterRead=globalThis[key]||0;return tagOk&&afterImport===before&&afterRead===before+1&&v===42;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: A deferred subtree containing top-level await cannot be deferred: those async modules are evaluated eagerly during loading, leaving only the synchronous parts deferred.
assertions.test: Requires the import defer grammar plus a dependency that uses top-level await; verify that the TLA module's side effect runs during loading while the synchronous module defers. Not machine-runnable on a browser that does not parse the grammar.
